2  CRL.P No. 103158 of 2023  C/W CRL.P No. 102703 of 2024  ORAL ORDER
Criminal Petition No.102703/2024 is filed by accused No.1 and Criminal Petition No.103158/2023 is fled by accused Nos.2 to 4.

Both the petitions are filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure seeking quashing of the order of cognizance dated 31.8.2021 and proceedings in C.C.
No.4506/2021 pending on the file of learned I Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Athani.
Since both the petitions arise out of the same crime number and the criminal case, they are taken up together for disposal.
2. Respondent No.2 has filed a private complaint in P.C. No.235/2021.
The learned Magistrate after recording the sworn statement has ordered for registration of criminal case against accused Nos.1 to 4.

Based on the said order, C.C. No.4506/2021 is registered against the petitioners for the offences under Sections 498A, 323, 324, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal NC:
2024:KHC-D:12921 Code (hereinafter referred to as the 'IPC', for short).
The proceedings of the said criminal case are sought to be quashed in these petitions.
3. An application under Section 482 read with Section 320 of the Code of Criminal Procedure of filed and it is signed by accused Nos.1 to 4, the respondent and their respective counsel.
The said application is supported by the affidavit of the respondent and accused No.1.

In the affidavit, the respondent has stated that she has agreed for one time settlement and agreed to receive Rs.6,50,000/- and she has already received Rs.2,00,000/- and agreed to receive the balance amount of Rs.4,50,000/- at the conclusion of M.C. No.3/2024 pending on the file of learned Senior Civil Judge, Athani.
4. The respondent, who is present before the Court, submits that there is no force or coercion of any person to enter into compromise.

She states NC: 2024:KHC-D:12921 that she will withdraw the allegations made in her complaint and in C.C. No.4506/2021 and she has no objection to quash the proceedings against the petitioners in C.C. No.4506/2021.
5. In view of the above terms, the proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to learned I Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Athani, are quashed.
6. Accordingly, both the petitions are disposed of.

Sd/-
